visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark shoulder-length hair stands confidently by a serene lake under a vast blue sky dotted with soft white clouds. She is wearing a white sleeveless top and has her arms crossed, looking directly into the camera with a subtle, gentle smile and glowing makeup. (2) A vertical split-screen montage appears; the top section shows her hands using a cushion puff to apply powder, the middle is a sun-drenched close-up of her face with closed eyes, and the bottom shows her applying blush with a brush while wearing a pink sweater. (3) The scene shifts to a low-angle shot of a tall pine tree with bright sunlight filtering through its dense green needles against a clear blue sky. This transition is followed by a shot of a sparkling blue lake seen from a moving vehicle's perspective. (4) Close-up shots show the woman in a white top applying a liquid product to her cheek. She then smiles warmly as high-contrast golden sunlight illuminates her skin, highlighting her radiant facial features. A hand is seen holding a black velvet makeup box with a gold brand logo. (5) Back at the lakeside, the woman uses a brush to apply blush from a pink and gold palette while looking at her reflection in a compact. She then walks away from the camera along the rocky shore, twirling gracefully and looking back over her shoulder with a smile. (6) The final shot is a high-angle flat lay of several luxury beauty products, including a multi-colored eyeshadow palette, a bottle of makeup base, and blushes, all neatly arranged on a clean, bright white wooden surface. The lighting is soft and even across the objects.
